newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy borrowing requirement to grow-Banking Assn..
newsitem.headline: Italy borrowing requirement to grow-Banking Assn..

text.p: Italy's public sector borrowing requirement will grow faster in the coming months than in January and February, Italy's Banking Association (ABI) said in a monthly report published on Wednesday.

"In the coming months ... a more sustained (rising) trend in the borrowing requirement is forecast," said the report, adding that in the first two months the borrowing requirement was 6.5 trillion lire, under the Eurostat definition.
That was more than 20 trillion lire less than in the same period of 1996.

Some 59.85 trillion lire worth of treasury paper falls due in March, 90.251 trillion lire in April, 67.175 trillion lire in May, 69.079 trillion lire in June, 52.250 trillion in July and 77.840 trillion in August.
